editorial:
Imagine waking up to find out you are about to go to jail for stealing money from your dad. That is exactly where Oliver finds himself. To make things worse, his rich wife is leaving him and won't help him out. In a total panic, he decides to take out a life insurance policy on her and hire a killer to do the dirty work. It sounds like a dark crime story, but it quickly turns into a wild, goofy ride. The whole vibe is light and silly, focusing on the chaos that happens when a bad plan goes completely wrong.

You will love how the plot spirals out of control when Oliver realizes the insurance policy is fake. The best part is the chase as he tries to stop the hit, only to find out the killers kept hiring other people to do the job. It is like a giant game of telephone but with assassins. While some of the jokes feel a bit old, the pacing keeps you hooked. You should definitely try to find this as a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends in total chaos as the chain of hitmen becomes way too long to track. Just when you think Oliver has stopped the cycle, the final killer arrives. In a funny twist, the plan fails completely. Instead of getting the money or getting away with the crime, Oliver ends up in a mess where he is the one in danger. It wraps up by showing that greed and bad planning always catch up to you in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and absurd plots.
